instagram.sub: 10 use cases, each with a copy-paste prompt

instagram.title: AI won't replace consultants. *It upgrades them.*
instagram.get: 10 consulting jobs, one tested prompt each

instagram.title: Rapid Data Analysis
instagram.what: Upload a client export and get trends, outliers and next questions
instagram.bestFor: A first pass on messy client data
instagram.prompt: You are a management consultant. Analyse the attached [DATASET] for [CLIENT GOAL]. Give: 1) the 5 biggest trends, 2) outliers worth a second look, 3) 3 questions for the client. Show the calculation behind every number, state each assumption and flag missing or odd data. Do not estimate figures that are not in the file.
instagram.meta: Tip: remove client names before you upload

instagram.title: Market Research
instagram.what: A sourced snapshot of a market: size estimates, drivers, key players
instagram.prompt: Research the [MARKET] in [REGION] for [CLIENT TYPE]. Summarise market size estimates, growth drivers, main players and recent regulation. Cite a dated source for every figure; where sources disagree, show the range. Mark anything older than 2 years. If you cannot find a number, write 'not found' instead of estimating.
instagram.meta: Tip: turn on web search before you paste

instagram.title: Strategy Frameworks
instagram.what: SWOT, PESTEL or Five Forces built for one client, not a template
instagram.prompt:
Build a [SWOT / PESTEL / Five Forces] for [CLIENT], a [BUSINESS] in [MARKET]. Use only my notes below plus sources you cite. For each point add the evidence and one 'so what' for the client. List the assumptions you made and 3 points to verify with the client.
Notes: [PASTE NOTES]
instagram.meta: Tip: run it once per framework, then compare

instagram.title: Competitive Intelligence
instagram.what: Side-by-side competitor profiles: offer, pricing, positioning, moves
instagram.prompt: Compare [CLIENT] with [COMPETITOR 1], [COMPETITOR 2] and [COMPETITOR 3]. Table: target customer, core offer, public pricing, positioning, moves in the last 12 months. Use their own sites and dated news, with a link for every cell. Write 'not public' where data is missing. End with 3 gaps [CLIENT] could own.
instagram.meta: Tip: re-run it monthly to catch new moves

instagram.title: Financial Modeling
instagram.what: A driver-based model with base, best and worst case you can change
instagram.prompt: Build a 3-year driver-based model for [BUSINESS / PROJECT] as a table I can paste into Excel or Sheets. Drivers: [PRICE, VOLUME, CHURN, COSTS]. Use only my inputs: [PASTE INPUTS]. Show base, best and worst case, the formula for each line and every assumption. Ask me for missing inputs instead of guessing.
instagram.meta: Tip: check every formula before it goes to a client

instagram.title: Instant Presentations
instagram.what: Turns findings into a storyline: one message per slide
instagram.prompt:
Turn these findings into a [10]-slide deck outline for [AUDIENCE] at [CLIENT]. Lead with the answer (pyramid principle). For each slide: an action title as one full sentence, 3 bullets, the chart to use and the finding it comes from. Do not add numbers that are not in my findings.
Findings: [PASTE]
instagram.meta: Tip: then ask for the slides as a file

instagram.title: Risk Assessment
instagram.what: A risk register: likelihood, impact, warning signs, mitigations
instagram.prompt:
Act as a risk advisor. For [PROJECT] at [CLIENT], build a risk register: risk, cause, likelihood 1-5, impact 1-5, early warning sign, mitigation, owner. Cover strategic, operational, financial, legal and people risks. Explain each score in one line, mark what is an assumption and flag the top 3 for this week.
Context: [PASTE]
instagram.meta: Tip: review the scores with the project owner

instagram.title: Performance Tracking
instagram.what: A weekly KPI read-out: what moved, why, and what to do next
instagram.prompt: Here are this week's KPIs for [CLIENT] vs last week and target: [PASTE TABLE]. Write a one-page read-out: what moved most, likely reasons (label each confirmed or hypothesis), which metric is off-track and 3 actions with an owner. Use only numbers from the table, show every % change calculation and ask if a target is missing.
instagram.meta: Tip: paste the same table format every week

instagram.title: Scenario Planning
instagram.what: 3-4 plausible futures, their triggers, and the moves for each
instagram.prompt: Plan scenarios for [CLIENT] over the next [TIMEFRAME]. Pick the 2 biggest uncertainties for [INDUSTRY], build 4 scenarios from them, and for each give: the story, early signals to watch, impact on [KEY METRIC] as a range, and no-regret moves. State every assumption, cite sources for external trends and never present a forecast as fact.
instagram.meta: Tip: revisit the early signals every quarter

instagram.title: Collaboration Readiness
instagram.what: An AI learning path for the client team, by role and level
instagram.prompt: Design a [6]-week AI learning path for [CLIENT TEAM] ([ROLES], [SKILL LEVEL]). For each week: one skill, one hands-on task using their real work, a 15-minute exercise and how to check it was learned. Recommend only free official courses (e.g. academy.claude.com) with links. Add the data and privacy rules the team must follow.
instagram.meta: Tip: start with the team's most repeated task

instagram.sub: Don't wait for the next engagement.
bullets: Pick one use case this week
Strip client names before you paste
